verdict.rationale: LibreChat's docs include a dedicated 'Subagents' feature page [librechat-docs-31], so first-party multi-agent support exists. The pack holds only that page title, plus the fact that agents can be invoked by '@' mention in chat [librechat-docs-23], with no description of how agents delegate or split work. missing for 10: any detail on how subagents delegate, split, or parallelize work; swarm or agent-to-agent protocol support; documentation beyond a page title; independent or hands-on corroboration.
